questions.question: The above passage _______ that an eight-hour sleep is natural.
questions.solution:
The phrase *‘history suggests that the **eight-hour sleep** **may** be **unnatural.**’* Thus, option 1 is incorrect.

The author carefully presents the studies conducted by *psychiatrist Thomas Wehr* and *historian Roger Ekirch* emphasizing* two distinct sleep chunk *patterns as opposed to the *general public perception* (the myth) *that we must sleep for eight consecutive hours*. Also, how the studies proved two distinct sleep cycles *started to disappear during the late 17th Century* before completely vanishing from our *social consciousness by 1920. *

Thus, the passage presents a__ thorough evaluation__ of __changing sleep patterns__ from the __15th century to the present.__

__Examine__:__ inspect thoroughly__ to determine their nature or condition.

Thus, option** 4** is the correct answer i.e. The above passage **__examines the myth__** that an eight-hour sleep is natural.

questions.question: What did the experiment conducted by Thomas Wehr prove?

options.text: It brought into question that sleeping for four consecutive hours is necessary.
It proved sleeping for eight consecutive hours is not a norm.
It established that when the nights are longer, people slept in two distinct chunks.
It proved that all people slept in two distinct chunks of four hours.

questions.solution:
In the second paragraph, the lines, *'the subjects had settled into a very distinct sleeping pattern. They __**slept first** __for __**four hours**__, **then woke** for **one or two hours** before** falling into a __second four-hour sleep__'*** prove that **sleeping for __eight consecutive hours __is __not__ a norm. **

Thus, option **2 **is the correct answer.

questions.question: Roger Ekirch indicated that _______.

options.text: sleeping for eight consecutive hours is a modern standard for sleep
a segmented sleeping pattern was an established common habit in nations with long winters.
a segmented sleeping patttern was historically established common old habit.
the practice of sleeping for eight consecutive hours was popularized by epics.

questions.solution:
In the second paragraph, **Roger Ekirch** gives ***historical evidence** that **humans** used to** sleep** in **two distinct chunks** -

1)**1595 engraving** by Jan Saenredam is evidence of activity at night,

2)**more than 500 references** to a **segmented sleeping pattern**-in diaries, court records, medical books, and literature, **from Homer's Odyssey** to an **anthropological account of modern tribes in Nigeria.***

Also, in the last paragraph, there is mention that ''It's not just the number of references - it is the **way **t**hey refer to it** as if **it was __common knowledge__', **"Ekirch said', thereby indicating a common old habit.

All of the above help us to understand, Roger Ekirch indicated that **a segmented sleeping patttern was historically established common old habit.**

Thus, option **3** is the correct answer.

questions.question: Which of the following options is NOT true with reference to the segmented sleeping pattern?
questions.solution:
In the last paragraph, it has been mentioned:

*'During this waking period (with reference to the segmented sleeping pattern), **people** were quite **active'.***

 
• *'they often got up, went to the toilet or smoked tobacco' *(indicating People were **physically active**). Thus, option 1 is incorrect.
 
• *'and some even** visited neighbors'**.* (indicating People were **socially active**). Thus, option 2 is incorrect.
 
• *'Most people stayed in bed, read, wrote and **often prayed'**.* (indicating People** prayed actively**). Thus, option 3 is incorrect.

Thus, option **4 **is NOT true and hence the correct answer with reference to the segmented sleeping pattern.

questions.question: What caused the idea of a first and second sleep to entirely recede from our social consciousness?

options.text: Industrialization and introduction of night shifts
A group of rich people defying sleep
An active night life facilitated by artificial lighting

questions.solution:
In the last few lines of the last paragraph, it has been mentioned that '*By the 1920s the **idea** of a **first** and **second sleep** had **receded entirely from our social consciousness.** He** attributes** the initial **shift **to** improvements in street lighting, domestic lighting** (i.e. Artificial Lighting) and a surge in coffee houses* - which were **sometimes** open all night'.

It has to be understood clearly that idea of a first and second sleep receded entirely from our social consciousness **primarily** due to improvements in Artificial Lighting whereas all night coffee houses provided just an additional impetus to it.

Thus, option **4 **is the most appropriate choice and hence is the correct answer.

Although many western cultures are moving towards more ____, less hierarchical organizations, the new research suggests _____ power structures and basic values of charity and fraternity are the cornerstones of successful societies.
questions.solution:
Here the correct answer is** liberal; traditional.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__

• Thus, **option 1** is incorrect as '**organized**' has a similar meaning. 
 
• Also '**substantial**' (of considerable importance) does not fit. Thus,** option 2 **is incorrect.
 
• __'__***__Liberal'__: __open__ to __new ideas__ **- *Opposite of '**hierarchical**' - Thus, is the **correct usage.**
 
• **2ⁿd Blank** - The sentence implies that though the western world is moving to liberal organizations, yet the new research suggests that **conventional **power structures and basic values of charity and fraternity are the cornerstones of successful societies.
 
• Thus, we need a word similar to conventional i.e. '**traditional**'.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **option 3.**

**__Correct Sentence:__ ***Although many western cultures are moving towards more __**liberal**__, less hierarchical organizations, the new research suggests __**traditional **__power structures and basic values of charity and fraternity are the cornerstones of successful societies.*

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select No substitution required.

Doing short bursts of high-intensity exercise can be__** most effective to weight loss than **__moderate workouts.

options.text: more effective to weight loss than
most effective for weight loss than
more effective for weight loss than

questions.solution:
The correct answer is option **4**.

Short bursts of high-intensity exercise are compared with moderate workouts. Thus, for comparison, comparative form **'more effective' **will be used instead of 'most effective'. Thus, option 3 is incorrect.

Also, 'most effective __**to**__ weight loss' is incorrect as 'to' is used with a verb. Thus, option 1 is incorrect.

The correct usage is 'most effective **for** weight loss' as 'for' is used with a Noun.

Example sentence:

I came to Delhi **to** work (**verb**).

I came to Delhi **for** a new job(**noun**).

Correct Sentence: Doing short bursts of high-intensity exercise can be **more effective** ***for*** weight loss than moderate workouts.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select No substitution required.

__**The World Health Organization were classified Internet gaming **__as an official mental health disorder.

options.text: The world Health Organization classify Internet gaming
The World Health Organization has classified Internet gaming
The World Health Organization classifying Internet gaming

questions.solution:
The correct answer is option **3.**

Here, ***Present Perfect Tense*** must be used as*** an effect of the Past action*** (i.e the classification of Internet gaming as an official mental health disorder ) ***continues on the Present day.***

Structure of a sentence in Present Perfect: Subject + has/have + V₃ ( Past Particle of the verb )

Correct Usage: __The World Health Organization were / *has* classified Internet gaming __as an official mental health disorder.
